advisor_identified: Historian of environmental history and science at Concordia University; supervisor of the 2016 Sydney industrial-pollution dissertation.

doctorate.title: Planting Improvement: The Rhetoric and Practice of Scientific Agriculture in Northern British America, 1670-1820

evidence.says: Concordia’s repository identifies the Sydney industrial-pollution dissertation as a History PhD dated August 2016 and lists Zilberstein, Anya as its thesis supervisor.

The faculty biography identifies Anya Zilberstein as a Concordia History professor, states that she joined the department in 2007, and gives her PhD as MIT, 2008, in History, Anthropology, and Science, Technology and Society.

MIT’s repository catalogue lists Anya Zilberstein as author of Planting Improvement: The Rhetoric and Practice of Scientific Agriculture in Northern British America, 1670-1820, issued in 2008, and describes it as a PhD thesis in History, Anthropology, and Science, Technology and Society at MIT.

notes: The linked record matches the doctorate’s author, institution, year and title. MIT catalogues the degree under its Program in Science, Technology and Society rather than the AHA department label History Faculty. The student repository title uses Recognizing the Dangers rather than Recognizing the Impacts. MIT catalogue metadata was available in the search result; direct page retrieval failed.
